issue.title: Re-stamp the running Pomodoro clock when Obsidian block-id-prompt naming retypes its linked tasks
issue.description:
Proposing bead: bob-cli-hc.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1, 2026-11-05), triaged by the bob-cli-hc land agent.

Since bob-cli-hc (offclock_types), a task's effective type can decide its clock: an area/project note's `offclock_types:` list sends only listed types off the clock (live vault: `love.md` and `body.md` carry `offclock_types: [MEET]`). bob-cli's `bob capture-pomodoro-name` re-stamps a running entry's `[t::]` / `[off::]` key after naming retypes its linked tasks (commit e6122f7a, bob-cli-hc.2).

The Obsidian naming path has no matching clock writer: bob-plugins `plugins/block-id-prompt/src/078-pomodoro-theme-write.js` retypes linked tasks through `api.themes.setTaskTheme` (set/clear/merge outcomes), and nothing in `plugins/block-id-prompt/src/` stamps `[off::]` or calls ledger-tools' `taskEffectiveOffClock`. So naming a running love entry `MEET` from Obsidian leaves it `[t::]` until the close re-stamps it, and the Now card, home chips, and Mac menu-bar indicator show Worked meanwhile. Closed rows are unaffected because the close re-stamps from the links it keeps.

Desired: when block-id-prompt naming renames a timed open entry and retypes its linked tasks, recompute that entry's clock key from its counted Task Links after the retypes, in the same write. Reuse ledger-tools' shared counted-links resolver (`taskEffectiveClockResolution` / `taskEffectiveOffClock` in `plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/036-pomodoro-clock.js`) rather than adding a second clock rule, and match bob-cli's `capture-pomodoro-name` behavior. See docs/capture.md "What counts" (row: "Naming a timed open entry ...").

task_type_fields.proposal: When block-id-prompt naming renames a timed open Pomodoro and retypes its linked tasks, recompute that entry's [t::]/[off::] key from its counted Task Links in the same write, reusing ledger-tools' shared clock resolver, matching bob capture-pomodoro-name.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved bob-cli-hc plan (plan:202611/offclock_types.md, plugin-mirror phase) explicitly said to leave the Obsidian naming path alone and record this as a follow-up; the epic's plugin scope was only the shared clock resolver and vectors.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-hc deliberately left the Obsidian naming path without a clock writer and asked for a follow-up; since offclock_types makes type an input to the clock, naming a running entry from Obsidian can leave its [t::]/[off::] key stale until close.
